title: Independent exact forward-basis audit of PR1611 helper450
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR1611 certifies helper450's scalar restoration using sparse rational row/column propagation. This independently corroborates that scalar premise by pushing every input basis vector forward with a separately written exact dyadic implementation. No discrepancy was found. Only `research/k8-hpe450-forward-audit/` is added: eight files, including the checker, deterministic receipt, source pins and review/validation records.

Both pinned local orientations have 24,767 events and 19,693 scalar operations. All 1,424 basis executions confirm the unit helper output row, its isolated dirt column and zero coefficients from all eight arbitrary private inputs. Six malformed programs reject with explicit exact coefficient witnesses. A dirt-leaking read preserves the row but leaks 1/2 to L230 forward and 1 to L27 backward. This is finite corroboration, not a new identity, Lean theorem, supplier admission or kappa.

The retained conditional C7 conclusion still needs exact event recipes and JSON-to-Lean correspondence. COPY/CLEAR lifetimes, other recipes, hosting/footprints, all-size compilation, precision/tape, complete costs and analytic transfer remain open. Selected sources/frontier and predecessor packages are unchanged.

## Task and overlap

Base current main `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`; contribution `a2078691245ff8d2825def7048680759b695cb49`. Task `formal-interface-lemma`, scope key `e3ffea67887eeb4c396c`, nonce `9c92a140d6ff014ccc0bdd30a86e9981`, revision 3. Scope refined to the scalar premise of one existing theorem-to-emission binding; exact card and stop rule are in TASK.json. [Claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1394#discussioncomment-18918131).

- [PR1611](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1611), exact head `156cc788b5a8122b19686f015e5654b117e4389d`: construction/binding predecessor; the new algorithm obtains the row by forward basis execution rather than reverse covector propagation. Its published verifier separately passes all 28 controls. No pending checker code is imported.
- [PR1415](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1415), `0d8d2c3a96346756f02563b401a042ab97198e20`: retained complex operator semantics, not repeated.
- [PR1697](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1697): parallel all-511 cold-hyperplane operator binding, a distinct domain.

Final overlap at 07:25 UTC read 393 open PR bodies, including drafts, through an empty numbered page; the helper also searched 875 local records. Discussions1163/1166/1394 and the active board were read live. Full Discussion pagination was unavailable, the helper warns about its absent Discussion cache, and concurrent merges make numbered pagination non-atomic. No-match output is not a novelty certificate.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/k8-hpe450-forward-audit
```

Registered replay passes on CPython3.12.14/macOS in 5.72s. Also passed: metadata/source pins, unchanged selected-record check, 18 repository onboarding tests, a read-only optimized source export without Git, source-drift and receipt-corruption rejection, and occupied-output preservation. Exact arithmetic is compared with Fraction over 4,624 operand pairs; a four-input dirty echo checks destructive COPY/CLEAR and inverse scales. Two bounded agent static reviews found no actionable issue. VALIDATION.json records actual commands/environment and separates negative exit codes from success.

No fresh Lean/Mathlib build, general serialization proof, physical hosting replay, full selected cold replay, hosted CI success or independent human review is claimed.

## Open next questions

[README](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a2078691245ff8d2825def7048680759b695cb49/research/k8-hpe450-forward-audit/README.md#open-next-questions) records the smallest useful follow-ups: translate this one helper into an actual Lean event word with private COPY/CLEAR lifetimes, or trace it through actual T16 hosted invocations. Scalar agreement does not discharge either missing correspondence or physical footprint proof.
